children.game_version: Partner trading game where children navigate floor pathways like Circle Left and change spots each musical strain.

seniors.seated_version: Perform arm-turns and progressive hand-clapping patterns in facing seated rows matching 32-bar phrasing.
seniors.standing_version: Gentle walking progression along longways lines, eliminating any quick footwork or sharp turns.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Moderate walking tempo with shortened floor travel distances.

feedback_rules.description: Identify failure to progress to the next position in the set during the 32-bar phrase iteration.

learning_units.description: Execute Circle Left smoothly within a set without breaking the circular line.
Perform the Strip the Willow weaving pattern across lines of partners.

prerequisites.description: Spatial awareness to maintain geometric floor patterns in longways and square sets.

social_formats.description: Longways sets for as many couples as will, or squares composed of four couples.

movement_profile.footwork: Regional and period-dependent stepping mixing English and French styling
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Longways sets for couples in lines or squares of four couples, tracing circular, serpentine, angular, and straight floor paths
movement_profile.partnering: Couples dancing interactive figures within a set with progressive movement

signature_moves.description: Intuitive circular floor pattern traced by dancers together in the set
signature_moves.name: Circle Left

signature_moves.description: Complex weaving figure executed across the set
signature_moves.name: Strip the Willow

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Dancing independently without regard to the set's progressive geometry

music_profile.musical_form: Symmetrical binary or multi-strain structure, most commonly 32 bars (jigs or reels)
music_profile.sound_description: Bright and rhythmic dance music organized into repeating strains, usually composed in 2/4 or 6/8 time. Designed to fit the length of dance figures, it commonly uses 32-bar structures characteristic of jigs and reels.

basic_steps: Stand in set formation facing partners or opposite lines
Trace circular path to the left (Circle Left)
Weave through opposite lines in progressive interaction (Strip the Willow)
Progress to new position in the set on the 32-bar cycle
teaching.formation: Longways sets of facing couples or four-couple squares
teaching.level_notes: Beginners start with simple intuitive floor paths such as circling before progressing to complex figures.
